_comment: SandBench restrictive seccomp profile (§6 hardening checklist).
This is a DENYLIST: default action is ALLOW, with clearly dangerous
syscalls forced to return EPERM. It blocks container-escape and
kernel-tampering primitives without breaking ordinary Python/Node
workloads. It is the MVP profile.
PRODUCTION: flip defaultAction to SCMP_ACT_ERRNO and enumerate an
allowlist (Docker's default profile is a good starting point), or move
to gVisor / Firecracker microVMs as noted in the build guide.

syscalls.comment: Block container escape, kernel tampering, and cross-process memory access.
